name: John Wiley
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Eight

items.text: John Shepard Wiley Jr. is an Associate Justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Eight, appointed in 2018. He served as a Superior Court judge from 2002 to 2018. Before that, he was a federal prosecutor and a tenured professor at UCLA Law School. He clerked for U.S. Supreme Court Justice Lewis F. Powell Jr. and First Circuit Judge Frank Coffin.
